profile.headline: Software Engineer | Internal Tools, Automation, and Practical AI Workflows
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer focused on practical internal tools, automation, and product workflow improvements. My background spans QA engineering, release support, frontend development, and process automation, which gives me a strong eye for where teams lose time to brittle tooling, manual checks, and unclear handoffs.

I like building useful systems that reduce friction: scripts, dashboards, workflow glue, AI-assisted processes, test tooling, and cleaner interfaces for real operational work. My strongest lane is connecting product quality, engineering execution, and automation in ways that make teams faster without making the stack more complicated than it needs to be.

I’m especially interested in software engineering roles where I can build and improve internal platforms, frontend tools, automation workflows, QA/release systems, and practical AI-assisted tooling for teams doing real work.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Engineer II working on product development, internal tooling, and practical automation workflows.

I work across frontend development, QA/process automation, scripting, and workflow cleanup. A lot of my focus is on turning messy operational needs into smaller systems that are easier to use and maintain.

Current areas of interest and work include:

- Building and maintaining software with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and related frontend tools.
- Creating internal tools and scripts that reduce repetitive manual work.
- Working with APIs, automation workflows, and AI-assisted tools to improve day-to-day processes.
- Bringing a QA background into engineering work: test planning, release awareness, edge cases, and practical reliability.
- Exploring agent-based workflows for follow-up, data cleanup, admin tasks, and handoff between systems.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Associate Software QA Analyst at Forsta
QA Engineer (Engineer III)
positions.description:
Worked closely with product, engineering, design, and QA teams to test new features, investigate bugs, and support release work.

My work included test planning, manual and automated testing, Cypress automation, Jira grooming, release notes, sprint planning support, and helping turn unclear product requirements into testable acceptance criteria.

This role gave me a strong QA foundation that still shapes how I write software now: think through edge cases, verify the user flow, and make sure the thing actually works outside the happy path.

positions.title: Associate Software QA Tester
positions.description:
* Created acceptance tests in TestRail to make an efficient testing experience for new features. 
* Helped brainstorm acceptance criteria with my teams and tested new features when ready for testing.
* Worked closely with project teams consisting of project owners, designers, engineers and QA. (DE & REV)
* Performed follow-up rounds of testing as needed for feature work / bug cards.
* Worked with documentation team to see the knowledge base is updated for software enhancements, bug fixes, and new products.

positions.title: Freelance Copywriter
positions.description:
Spinning philosophy from intellectual to practical everyday value is not easy. We often fall into that intellectual trap of "I'm smarter than you because," mentality which distances us from having good relationships with each other. 

I have my blog The Art of Emotional Alchemy which touches on this and how to drop our limitations from moment to moment so we can better relate and share with each other. 

I also have a self-published book called Emotional Alchemist which is jam packed with ways in which we can transform our perspective to better see ourselves and others.

positions.title: Web Developer and Marketing
positions.description: In charge of maintenance on the marketing site  which consists of creating new content, A/B split testing, pop-up integration,  and social media marketing.  I've also had the title of QA here where I created acceptance tests and utilized those tests to ensure quality of our software.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Now part of Bitwises Cohort development team. I will be implementing various skills in web development to succeed in helping clients meet their web design needs. From HTML5/CSS3, PHP, Javascript, Wordpress Custom Themes, to CRUD applications. We are currently working with on projects while honing our web development skills
